lines.trans: My dad is an irresponsible eccentric.
And I have been waiting for my prince for a long time.
Probably his horse fell ill.

lines.trans: And the restaurant owner is no better than the horse.
He parties himself, yet scolds me.
But you should perceive everything like this!

lines.trans: My dad is still full of energy!
And soon I will have a brother!

On the bright side, I am young and beautiful!

meanings.en: to perceive, to take (in a certain way)
meanings.note: воспринимать всё всерьёз = to take everything seriously

examples.trans: You see everything in a gloomy light.

гулять.gloss: to walk, to go for a walk

meanings.note: Гулять с собакой = to walk the dog.

examples.trans: We went for a walk in the park.

examples.text: Илья Олегович! Я не могу гулять здесь целый день.

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

meanings.note: with present: Я давно здесь = I've been here a long time

examples.trans: You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

meanings.note: + genitive.

examples.text: Вчера он заболел и остался дома.

зато.gloss: but on the other hand, to make up for it

meanings.en: but on the other hand, at least
meanings.note: introduces a compensating positive fact

examples.text: Четыре по алгебре, зато по физкультуре пятёрка.
examples.trans: A four in algebra, but a five in gym.
